name: ade
description: ADE — Agent Development Environment: one workspace, every device, every agent.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ade/shared && npm run build -w @ade/server && npm run build -w @ade/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm:dev -w @ade/server" "npm:dev -w @ade/web"
